WITH l AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'∼(\d+) nm',1) AS DOUBLE) AS nm FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L23'),
d AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'^([0-9.]+)',1) AS DOUBLE) AS mant,
 CASE WHEN text LIKE '%−%' THEN -1.0 ELSE 1.0 END * CAST(regexp_extract(text,'(\d+)$',1) AS DOUBLE) AS ex
 FROM cells WHERE id='p14.T5.r13c2'),
u AS (SELECT (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_mega') AS mega, (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.per_kilo') AS kilo,
 (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.s_per_min') AS s_min, (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.min_per_h') AS min_h, (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id='K.h_per_day') AS h_day)
SELECT (l.nm/(u.mega*u.kilo))*(l.nm/(u.mega*u.kilo)) / ((d.mant*POWER(10, d.ex))/(100*100)) AS t_seconds,
 (l.nm/(u.mega*u.kilo))*(l.nm/(u.mega*u.kilo)) / ((d.mant*POWER(10, d.ex))/(100*100)) / (u.s_min*u.min_h) AS t_hours,
 (l.nm/(u.mega*u.kilo))*(l.nm/(u.mega*u.kilo)) / ((d.mant*POWER(10, d.ex))/(100*100)) / (u.s_min*u.min_h*u.h_day) AS t_days
FROM l, d, u

rendered: Using the review's equation, the diffusion time is the squared diffusion length divided by the lithium-ion diffusivity.[1] For ZrO2, Table 5[2] gives a lithium-ion diffusivity of[3] 1.7 ×10^− 18[4] cm^2/s at the stated temperature. For a coating thickness of 10 nm[5] (taken as the diffusion length), the diffusion time is about 588,235[6] seconds, or about 6.8[7] days (about 163[8] hours) for a lithium ion to cross the coating. This is a calculated estimate from the review's equation and tabulated diffusivity, not a measured value.
